about: Saint-Constant is a South Shore city in Montérégie, southwest of Montréal near the St. Lawrence Seaway and Autoroute 30. It mixes older village streets with newer suburban neighbourhoods and is known regionally for the Exporail Canadian Railway Museum. Agricultural land still borders parts of the municipality. About 30,000 people live in Saint-Constant.
seoSummary: South Shore city near the Seaway, home to the Exporail Canadian Railway Museum.
